Md. Azharul Islam ------ Appellant.
Vs.
Md. Idris Ali and anr ------ Respondent.
full_judgment: 3. Defendant No. 1 Idris Ali contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations and contending, inter alia, that the father of the plaintiff since 1950 has been possessing the suit property as a monthly tenant on payment of Tk. 38/- per month. After his father the plaintiff has been possessing the suit property on payment of monthly rent at first at the rate of Tk. 75/- per month. The plaintiff has been running his pharmacy in the name and style of the Star Medical Hall in the suit premises. The defendant No. 1 found the plaintiff to be undesirable tenant. He used to delay in the matter of payment of rents. Defendant No. 1 wanted to run his own business in the suit premises and asked the plaintiff to vacate the premises. Thereafter on creating a forged and fabricated Bainapatra the plaintiff sent his advocate's letter dated 31-3-80 to defendant No. 1 asking him to transfer the suit property by executing and registering a deed in his favour. The plaintiff never paid Tk. 5,030/ to the defendant as earnest money and defendant No. 1 also never agreed in any majlish on 1-6-79 to sell the suit property to the plaintiff at a price of Tk. 50,000/-. The defendant No. 1 never executed any Bainapatra. The alleged Bainapatra is forged and fabricated. The defendant No. 1 further asserted that the market price of the suit property should be Tk. 2,00,000/-. The suit is, therefore, liable to be dismissed.
